newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - Basis levels steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - Basis levels steady to higher.

text.p: Basis bids for hard red winter wheat were steady to higher at terminals and elevators in the High Plains, and grain dealers said cash movement was slow Thursday.
"I think they raised those basis levels at interior points because of domestic milling demand," an Oklahoma dealer said.

Weather conditions were expected to be mild and sunny across HRW wheat growing regions Thursday. Meteorologist Weather Express said high temperatures were expected to be in the mid 50s in northern Kansas and in the 60s in southern Kansas, Oklahoma and Texas.
